info.title: Account Management API
info.description: Moment's Account Management API allows Clients to manage their accounts and associated data.

schema.description: The ID of the account

parameters.name: slim
parameters.description: When true, return a reduced account payload containing only account-level metadata (see the AccountDetailSlim schema) and omit the heavier lots, cash, sleeves, statistics, and compliance data. Defaults to false.

200.description: Successful response. Returns AccountDetail, or AccountDetailSlim when slim=true.

post.description: Uploads a document for a custodian account. The document payload is stored as a text file in the organization's document store. The organization is resolved from the authenticated API key.

custodian_account_id.description: The custodian's identifier for the account.

payload_type.description: The category of document being uploaded.

status.description: Always "ok" when the document was stored.

403.description: Organization not permitted to upload documents

schema.description: Standard error response format returned by all API endpoints.

error.description: Human-readable error message describing what went wrong.

error_details.description: Additional structured information about the error.

error_type.description: High-level error category for programmatic error handling.

Customizations.description: Sleeve customizations, keyed by asset class. Entries live under an asset-class bucket: fixed-income constraints under `fixed_income`. A bare map of entries at the top level (no asset-class bucket) is a legacy shape that is still accepted but is normalized into `fixed_income` on write; new integrations should send the container shape.

fixed_income.description: Fixed-income constraints, keyed by a caller-supplied entry id (e.g. "allocation_20260609"). Each entry is a universe filter or an allocation target.

sleeves.description: An object containing all of the account's sleeves keyed by sleeve ID

AccountDetailSlim.description: A reduced account payload returned by GET /v1/account/{account_id}/ when slim=true. Contains only account-level metadata; the heavier lots, cash, sleeves, statistics, and compliance data are omitted.

isin.title: ISIN
isin.description: The International Securities Identification Number (ISIN) is a 12-digit alphanumeric code that uniquely identifies a specific security.

cusip.title: CUSIP
cusip.description:
CUSIP is a nine-digit numeric or nine-character alphanumeric code that identifies a North American financial security.
Note: Available to licensed users only. The Committee on Uniform Securities Identification Procedures (CUSIP) identifier for all stocks and registered bonds. CUSIPs are unique security identifiers managed by The CUSIP Service Bureau.

status.description:
The status of the bond reflects many possible states a bond can be in.

* called: The bond has been called by the issuer.
* converted: The bond has been converted into another type of security. Usually this is from the issue being converted into common stock.
* defaulted: The bond issuer has failed to make timely payments on the bond and has entered default.
* funged: The bond has been funged (replaced/exchanged) for another. This sometimes happens when an issuer combines two classes of bond into one parent bond.
* liquidated: The issuer has been liquidated.
* matured: The bond has reached its maturity date and the bondholders have been repaid their principal.
* outstanding: The bond is still active and has not reached its maturity date.
* pre_issuance: There is reference data for this bond but it has not yet been issued and is unavailable for trading.
* put: The bond has been put (sold back) to the issuer.
* repaid: The bond has been repaid before its maturity date using a covenant other than an option such as a put or call. For example, through prepayment.
* tendered: The bond has been tendered (offered for repurchase) by the issuer.
* repurchased: The bond has been repurchased by the issuer.
* restructured: The security has been restructured into a new security or into a security with materially different terms.
* unknown: The status of the bond is unknown.

type.description: The type of fixed income security.

treasury_subtype.description:
The subtype of a treasury. Possible values include:
* bond: long term i.e. 20, 30 years
* note: intermediate term i.e. 2, 3, 5, 7, and 10 years
* bill: short term i.e. 4, 8, 13, 17, 26, 52 weeks (<= 1 year)
* tips: treasury inflation-protected securities
* strips: separate trading of registered interest and principal of securities
* floating: floating rate notes

maturity_date.description: The date on which the bond matures and the principal amount is paid back to the bondholder by the issuer. Note: not all bonds have a maturity date, such as perpetual bonds.

coupon.description: The coupon is the annual interest rate paid on the bond as a percentage of par value. This field is set to zero for zero-coupon bonds.

close_price.description: The close price, or 'end of day price' is the price of the last transaction of a security before the market closes for normal trading, shown as a percentage of par value. Note: available to users licensed for end-of-day prices only.

close_yield_to_worst.description: The close Yield to Worst refers to the YTW of the last transaction of a security before the market officially closes for normal trading. Note: available to users licensed for end-of-day prices only.

close_yield_to_maturity.description: The close Yield to Maturity refers to the YTM of the last transaction of a security before the market officially closes for normal trading. Note: available to users licensed for end-of-day prices only.

issuer.example: AAA United States Government Money Market Account Inc.

callable.description: Whether the bond is callable, meaning the issuer has the right, but not the obligation to redeem the bond — in other words, pay out the bondholder — before its maturity date at a set price (the call price).

next_call_date.description: The date of the next possible call on the bond. Null if the bond is not callable.

next_call_price.description: The price at which a callable bond can be redeemed by the issuer on the next call date, as a percentage of par. Null if the bond is not callable.

municipal_taxable_federal.description: Whether a municipal bond is subject to US federal taxes. Only specified for municipal bonds.

municipal_state.description: The state or territory of the issuing municipality formatted as a two-letter USPS state abbreviation. Only specified for municipal bonds.

purpose.description: The purpose of a bond refers to the specific reason or the objective for which the bond is issued. It defines how the issuer intends to use the funds raised from the bond sale. May be null for bonds where the purpose is not captured in the prospectus.

use_of_proceeds.description: A more detailed explanation of how the issuer will use the money raised from the bond issuance. For example: Construction of new facilities, refinancing existing debt, general corporate purposes, etc.
use_of_proceeds.example: Construction of water treatment plant and related infrastructure improvements

accrued_interest.description: The interest that has accumulated on a bond in dollars per bond bewteen the last interest payment and the present date that has not yet been paid to the bondholder.

price.description: The latest evaluated price of the instrument, as a percentage of par.

yield_to_worst.description: The latest evaluated yield to worst of the instrument.

yield_to_maturity.description: The latest evaluated yield to maturity of the instrument.

par_value.description: The instrument's par value. Usually 1000 for most bond types. Usually 5000 for municipal bonds.

description.description: Full text description of the bond following the format: [issuer] [coupon]%, [maturity_date: MM/DD/YYYY]
description.example: AAA UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT MONEY MARKET ACCOUNT INC 2.6%, 11/30/2022

description_short.description: Short text description of the bond following the format: [abbreviated issuer] [coupon]% [maturity_date: MM/DD/YYYY]

sp_rating.description: Standard & Poor's rating for the bond in the standard AAA - D format. NR if marked as not rated by the agency. Null if there is no rating (AAA - D or NR) provided by the agency. Note: available to S&P licensed users only. This data includes Standard & Poor's (S&P) ratings and related financial information. S&P ratings and data are proprietary to Standard & Poor's Financial Services LLC. The information is used under license and is subject to copyright and other intellectual property rights held by Standard & Poor's or its affiliates.

moodys_rating.description: Moody's rating for the bond in the standard Aaa - C format. NR if marked as not rated by the agency. Null if there is no rating (Aaa - C or NR) provided by the agency. Note: available to Moody's licensed users only. This data includes Moody's ratings and related financial information. Moody's ratings and data are proprietary to Moody's Corporation. The information is used under license and is subject to copyright and other intellectual property rights held by Moody's or its affiliates.

duration.description: The duration of a bond represents how long it will take, on average, to receive the returns of investment, including the regular interest payments on the bond as well as the final lump sum payment. Moment provides modified duration, a modification of Macaulay duration (which measures the weighted average time it takes to receive all cash flows, both interest and principal, from a bond). Modified duration provides a more direct measure of a bond's price sensitivity to interest rates, as it provides an estimate for how much the price of a bond will change in response to a 1% change in interest rates. Note: this field is available to users licensed for pricing analytics only.

sector.description: Sector classification of issuer (e.x. Financial Services, Healthcare Facilities, Industrials, Professional Services, Energy, etc.)

principal_factor.description: The principal factor of the bond.

tax_state.description: The state or territory where the account is taxable

period_length.title: Period Length
period_length.description: The length of one ladder period in months.

start_period.title: Start Period
start_period.description: The starting period of the ladder.

end_period.title: End Period
end_period.description: The ending period of the ladder.

weight_tolerance.title: Weight Tolerance
weight_tolerance.description: The maximum weight deviation allowed for each bucket in the ladder.

market_value_tolerance.title: Market Value Tolerance
market_value_tolerance.description: The maximum market value deviation allowed for each bucket in the ladder, which can be specified instead of weight_tolerance.

grace_period_months.title: Grace Period Months
grace_period_months.description: The length of the grace period in months. The grace period is the time period after the assignment date where a dynamic ladder policy constraint are not yet being adjusted.

use_call_adjusted_maturity.title: Use Call Adjusted Maturity
use_call_adjusted_maturity.description: The call adjusted maturity date is the terminal date of the bond implied by its yield to worst. If set to true then the ladder policy constraint will use the call adjusted maturity date instead of the maturity date.

Lot.description: A security lot. Every quantity carries the sign the custodian reported it under, which does not indicate direction: most custodians report a short position as a negative quantity, but some report it as positive. Read position_type to determine direction.

custodian_lot_id.description: The ID of the lot in the custodian's system

sleeve_id.description: The ID of the sleeve that the lot belongs to

accrued_interest.description: The amount of interest that has accrued, but not yet been paid to to the bondholder since the last interest payment. The size of the interest payment we'd make or receive if we were to trade this this entire lot right now. Derived from open_quantity, so it carries the same sign.

basis_date.description: The basis date of the lot

basis_quantity.description: The basis quantity of the lot

basis_price.description: The basis price of the lot in percentage of par

book_ytm.description: The yield to maturity calculated at purchase time using basis price and date

book_ytc.description: The yield to call calculated at purchase time using basis price and date (null if not callable)

book_ytw.description: The yield to worst calculated at purchase time using basis price and date

is_short_position.description: Whether the lot is a short position. Deprecated — read position_type instead. True exactly when position_type is "short".

settled_closed_quantity.description: The settled closed quantity of the lot

settled_open_quantity.description: The settled open quantity of the lot

unsettled_closed_quantity.description: The unsettled closed quantity of the lot

unsettled_open_quantity.description: The unsettled open quantity of the lot

moment_reserved_quantity.description: The reserved quantity of the lot

open_quantity.description: The total open quantity of the lot. Equal to the sum of settled_open_quantity, unsettled_open_quantity, and moment_reserved_quantity.

open_market_value.description: The total open market value of the lot based on open_quantity, the latest instrument price, and accrued interest, if known. Derived from open_quantity, so it carries the same sign.

wash_sale.description: Whether the lot is a wash sale

PositionType.description: The direction of a lot: "long" is a position the account owns, "short" one it owes. Direction is deliberately separate from quantity, whose sign is a per-custodian storage convention and says nothing about it.

ManagementType.description: "sma" for separately managed accounts. "uma" for unified managed accounts. null for accounts that are not classified as either an SMA or a UMA.

MinCashSettingMode.description: The mode of an account's minimum-cash floor: a fixed dollar amount or a fraction of account value.

MinCash.description: An account's minimum-cash floor. Present only when a floor is configured. min_cash_setting selects the mode; the matching value field is populated.

min_cash_dollar.description: The minimum-cash floor as a fixed dollar amount. Present when min_cash_setting is "dollar".

min_cash_percent.description: The minimum-cash floor as a fraction of account value, expressed as a decimal in the range (0, 1] — e.g. "0.05" means 5%. Present when min_cash_setting is "percent".

BufferCash.description: The cash an account wants parked in its funding sleeve, as a min/target/max. A placement target for cash rebalancing, not a floor on what can be invested — that is min_cash. Present only when at least one bound is configured; an unconfigured bound is omitted.

buffer_cash_min_percent.description: The buffer's minimum, as a fraction of managed value expressed as a decimal in [0, 1] — e.g. "0.05" means 5%. Not a whole-number percent.

buffer_cash_target_percent.description: The buffer's target, as a fraction of managed value expressed as a decimal in [0, 1] — e.g. "0.05" means 5%. Not a whole-number percent.

buffer_cash_max_percent.description: The buffer's maximum, as a fraction of managed value expressed as a decimal in [0, 1] — e.g. "0.05" means 5%. Not a whole-number percent.

AllocationSum.description: How an account's managed sleeve targets plus its buffer cash target compare to 100%, as computed by accounts-api. The verdict is balanced when the total is within 1e-6 of 1, under_allocated below that, and over_allocated above it. Fractions are decimals in [0, 1] serialized as strings — e.g. "0.05" means 5%.

managed_target_sum.description: The sum of target_allocation over the sleeves in included_sleeve_ids: standard, managed, non-default, non-transitioning, weight-basis sleeves that carry weights.

buffer_cash_target_percent.description: The account's buffer_cash_target_percent setting. Omitted when the account has none.

notional_sleeve_ids.description: The market-value-basis sleeves excluded from the sum.

notional_total.description: The dollar targets of notional_sleeve_ids summed, in account currency (USD).

template_owned.description: Whether some sleeve on the account carries a live asset allocation template id (one that is not transitioning). Under-allocation is a violation only on a template-owned account; over-allocation always is.

violation.description: accounts-api's policy result: over_allocated, or under_allocated on a template-owned account. Render warnings from this flag rather than re-deriving the rule; the guarded sleeve writes refuse on it.

remaining.description: How far total falls short of 1.

name.description: The name of the proposal. Generated by the portfolio management system.

created_at.description: The date and time when the proposal was created.

generated_at.description: The date and time when the optimization to generate the proposal was completed, if applicable.

failed_at.description: The date and time when the optimization to generate the proposal failed, if applicable.

submitted_at.description: The date and time when the proposal was submitted for execution, if applicable.

canceled_at.description: The date and time when the proposal was canceled, if applicable.

completed_at.description: The date and time when the proposal was completed, if applicable.

num_accounts.description: The number of accounts in the proposal.

market_value.description: The total market value of the proposed orders in the proposal.

num_orders.description: The number of orders in the proposal.

filled_market_value.description: The total market value of the filled orders in the proposal.

num_filled_orders.description: The number of orders in the proposal that have been filled.

proposal_status.description:
The current status of the proposal.
running: The optimizer is currently running and has not yet generated proposed orders.
failed: The optimizer failed to generate proposed orders.
canceled: The user canceled the proposal before submitting it for execution.
in_review: The optimizer has generated proposed orders, and the user is now reviewing the orders prior to submitting them.
executing: The user has submitted the proposed orders, but they have not yet all reached a terminal state.
completed: The user has submitted the proposed orders and they have all reached a terminal state.

model_id.description: The ID of the model to of which the sleeve should be assigned

model_name.description: The name of the model to which the sleeve is assigned

assignment_date.description: Assignment dates are used to align ladders and determine grace periods for the first ladder bucket before dynamic ladder rebalancing kicks in

meta.description: Arbitrary key-value store for additional metadata

amount.description: The amount of cashflow to target per period

start_date.description: The date on which the cashflow target starts being applied. This date is inclusive. Must be in the format YYYYMMDD, i.e. 20250101. If not provided, the cashflow target will start on the current date.

end_date.description: The date on which the cashflow target stops being applied. This date is exclusive. Must be in the format YYYYMMDD, i.e. 20251231.

frequency.description:
The frequency of the cashflow.

* one_time: Cashflow is a one-time payment.
* monthly: Cashflow is distributed monthly.
* bimonthly: Cashflow is distributed every two months.
* quarterly: Cashflow is distributed quarterly.
* semiannually: Cashflow is distributed twice per year.
* annually: Cashflow is distributed annually.

source.description:
The source of the cashflow.

* coupon: Cashflow is derived from coupon payments.
* principal: Cashflow is derived from principal payments.
* coupon_and_principal: Cashflow is derived from both coupon and principal payments.

call_assumption.description:
The assumption made about when bonds will be called.

* maturity_date: Assumes bonds are held until maturity.
* workout_date: Assumes bonds are called at the workout date.
* next_call_date: Assumes bonds are called at the next call date.

overrides.description:
Custom cashflow amounts to override specific buckets. Keys are bucket date ranges in format
"YYYYMMDD_YYYYMMDD" (start_end), values are the override amount.
Example: {"20250301_20250401": 13000} overrides the March 2025 bucket for a monthly frequency starting on the 1st.

id.description: A unique identifier for this sleeve

name.description: A descriptive name for the sleeve

allocation_basis.description: The basis for calculating the allocation of the sleeve

priority.description: The priority in which cash is allocated to sleeves based on their target allocations. Lower values are allocated first.

min_allocation.description: The lowest proportion of the total market value of the account's non-cash holdings we'd like assigned to this sleeve

target_allocation.description: The desired proportion of the total market value of the account's non-cash holdings we'd like assigned to this sleeve

max_allocation.description: The highest proportion of the total market value of the account's non-cash holdings we'd like assigned to this sleeve

is_default.description: Whether the sleeve is the default sleeve. There is exactly one default sleeve. The default sleeve may not be deleted.

is_managed.description: Whether the advisor manages this sleeve. Managed sleeves are billed, count toward the account's managed value and are optimized; unmanaged sleeves are excluded from all three.

timestamp.description: RFC-3339 timestamp with nanosecond precision representing the time at which these statistics were generated

total_market_value.description: The total market value of the holdings in the sleeve. Equal to the sum of treasury_market_value, corporate_market_value, agency_market_value, cd_market_value, municipal_market_value, money_market_market_value, and government_market_value.

treasury_market_value.description: The total market value of all U.S. Treasury bond holdings in the sleeve

corporate_market_value.description: The total market value of all corporate bond holdings in the sleeve

agency_market_value.description: The total market value of all agency bond holdings in the sleeve

government_market_value.description: The total market value of all foreign government bond holdings in the sleeve

municipal_market_value.description: The total market value of all municipal bond holdings in the sleeve

money_market_market_value.description: The total market value of all money market holdings in the sleeve

cd_market_value.description: The total market value of all CD holdings in the sleeve

total_accrued_interest.description: The total accrued interest of the account

average_ytw.description: The average yield to worst across all holdings in the sleeve

average_maturity.description: The average time to maturity across all holdings in the sleeve

average_duration.description: The average duration of the holdings in the sleeve

average_sp_rating.description: The average S&P credit rating across all holdings in the sleeve

average_moodys_rating.description: The average Moody's credit rating across all holdings in the sleeve

average_coupon.description: The average coupon rate across all holdings in the sleeve

average_book_ytm.description: The average yield to maturity calculated at purchase time using basis price and date

average_book_ytw.description: The average yield to worst calculated at purchase time using basis price and date

compliant.description: Whether the sleeve weight is compliant with the limits.

min_weight.description: The minimum weight of the sleeve.

target_weight.description: The target weight of the sleeve.

max_weight.description: The maximum weight of the sleeve.

current_weight.description: The current weight of the sleeve.

compliant.description: Whether the sleeve market value is compliant with the limits.

min_market_value.description: The minimum market value allocation in dollars.

required_market_value.description: The required market value floor allocation in dollars.

target_market_value.description: The target market value allocation in dollars.

max_market_value.description: The maximum market value allocation in dollars.

Uses start-of-day settled cash rather than current cash (which includes unsettled intraday activity), so it reflects cash that can be withdrawn immediately today. ClientOrderID.title: Client Order ID
ClientOrderID.description: Client-provided unique ID for the order; for example, to cross-reference with an internal system. Must be unique within the trading day, otherwise duplicate orders will be rejected during pre-trade checks.

OrderRFQ.title: Order Request RFQ
OrderRFQ.description: Required for orders of type `rfq_response`, specifies the RFQ that the order is being placed against.

id.description: The ID of the RFQ that led to the order request.

contra_quote_id.title: Contra Quote ID
contra_quote_id.description: The ID of the quote that is being traded against.

OrderSide.title: OrderSide
OrderSide.description:
Represents which side this order is on:

- buy
- sell

OrderSize.title: Size
OrderSize.description: The size of an order, with a specified `type` indicating how the size is represented. Par sizes represent the size of the order in face value; most corporate bonds have a face value of $1000, so an order with par $3000 would represent an order for 3 bonds. Notional sizes represent the size of the order in current dollar value, so an order with notional $3000 would represent an order to buy or sell $3000 worth of the bond at the current market prices. Currently, only par sizes are supported.

OrderType.description:
Represents the types of orders Moment currently supports.

- limit
- market
- rfq_response

PostOrderRequest.description: Each order has a unique identifier generated by Moment. The ID will be returned when an order is placed and can be used to check the status of the order via the `GET /v1/trading/order/{id}/` endpoint. Updates on open orders at Moment will also be sent over the real-time API, which is the recommended method of maintaining order state.
PostOrderRequest.title: Order Request

limit_price.description: The Percentage Price is represented as a percentage of par. For a typical $1,000 par value bond, a percentage price of $90 values the bond at $900. This is a clean price, which does not include accrued interest.

booking_instructions.title: booking_instructions
booking_instructions.description: Client-provided information to configure trade booking for the order, as a map from string to string. Passing a multi-layer JSON map or something other than "string":"string" key-value pairs will result in an error. The specific contents of this field should be determined in conjunction with the back-office integration.

extended_hours.description: (default) false. If true, eligible for execution outside regular trading hours. In live mode, trading hours are from 9:30 am to 4:00 pm ET. Extended hours are from 7:30 am to 5:30 pm ET. For paper trading, normal trading hours are from 9:30 am to 4:00 pm ET. Extended hours are from 1:00 am to 11:00 pm ET.

metadata.description: Metadata is an arbitrary key-value store for client-provided data associated with the order.

review_required.description: Flag to indicate if the order requires manual review before execution.

review_reason.description: Reason for why the order requires review. Only applicable when review_required is true.

id.title: ID
id.description: Moment-generated ULID identifier for the order

max_allocation.description: The highest proportion of the total market value of the account's non-cash holdings we'd like assigned to this sleeve

required_market_value.description: An optional absolute floor, in account currency (USD), on the sleeve's target market value. When omitted, no market value floor is applied.

is_managed.description: Whether the advisor manages this sleeve. Managed sleeves are billed, count toward the account's managed value and are optimized; unmanaged sleeves are excluded from all three. Defaults to true. A sleeve created with a model assignment cannot be unmanaged.

client_id.description: An optional caller-supplied external identifier for the sleeve. Must be unique within the account. When omitted, it defaults to the generated sleeve_id.

sleeve_id.description: A unique identifier generated by the server

client_id.description: The caller-supplied external identifier for the sleeve, or the generated sleeve_id when none was supplied.

400.description: Invalid request parameters, or accounts-api refused the sleeve because its target does not fit the account's remaining allocation. On a refusal, error_details.allocation_sum carries the account's AllocationSum as computed before the write, so a caller can show how much room is left.

409.description: A sleeve with the same client_id or name already exists in the account.

Customizations.description: Sleeve customizations, keyed by asset class. Entries live under an asset-class bucket: fixed-income constraints under `fixed_income`. A bare map of entries at the top level (no asset-class bucket) is a legacy shape that is still accepted but is normalized into `fixed_income` on write; new integrations should send the container shape.

fixed_income.description: Fixed-income constraints, keyed by a caller-supplied entry id (e.g. "allocation_20260609"). Each entry is a universe filter or an allocation target.

AllocationBasis.title: Allocation Basis
AllocationBasis.description: Specifies how allocation targets and bounds are specified.

AllocationSum.description: How an account's managed sleeve targets plus its buffer cash target compare to 100%, as computed by accounts-api. The verdict is balanced when the total is within 1e-6 of 1, under_allocated below that, and over_allocated above it. Fractions are decimals in [0, 1] serialized as strings — e.g. "0.05" means 5%.

managed_target_sum.description: The sum of target_allocation over the sleeves in included_sleeve_ids: standard, managed, non-default, non-transitioning, weight-basis sleeves that carry weights.

buffer_cash_target_percent.description: The account's buffer_cash_target_percent setting. Omitted when the account has none.

notional_sleeve_ids.description: The market-value-basis sleeves excluded from the sum.

notional_total.description: The dollar targets of notional_sleeve_ids summed, in account currency (USD).

template_owned.description: Whether some sleeve on the account carries a live asset allocation template id (one that is not transitioning). Under-allocation is a violation only on a template-owned account; over-allocation always is.

violation.description: accounts-api's policy result: over_allocated, or under_allocated on a template-owned account. Render warnings from this flag rather than re-deriving the rule; the guarded sleeve writes refuse on it.

remaining.description: How far total falls short of 1.

CreateSleeveErrorDetails.description: Present only when the create was refused because the sleeve's target does not fit the account's remaining allocation.

model_id.description: The ID of the model to of which the sleeve should be assigned

model_name.description: The name of the model to which the sleeve is assigned

assignment_date.description: Assignment dates are used to align ladders and determine grace periods for the first ladder bucket before dynamic ladder rebalancing kicks in

meta.description: Arbitrary key-value store for additional metadata

amount.description: The amount of cashflow to target per period

start_date.description: The date on which the cashflow target starts being applied. This date is inclusive. Must be in the format YYYYMMDD, i.e. 20250101. If not provided, the cashflow target will start on the current date.

end_date.description: The date on which the cashflow target stops being applied. This date is exclusive. Must be in the format YYYYMMDD, i.e. 20251231.

frequency.description:
The frequency of the cashflow.

* one_time: Cashflow is a one-time payment.
* monthly: Cashflow is distributed monthly.
* bimonthly: Cashflow is distributed every two months.
* quarterly: Cashflow is distributed quarterly.
* semiannually: Cashflow is distributed twice per year.
* annually: Cashflow is distributed annually.

source.description:
The source of the cashflow.

* coupon: Cashflow is derived from coupon payments.
* principal: Cashflow is derived from principal payments.
* coupon_and_principal: Cashflow is derived from both coupon and principal payments.

call_assumption.description:
The assumption made about when bonds will be called.

* maturity_date: Assumes bonds are held until maturity.
* workout_date: Assumes bonds are called at the workout date.
* next_call_date: Assumes bonds are called at the next call date.

overrides.description:
Custom cashflow amounts to override specific buckets. Keys are bucket date ranges in format
"YYYYMMDD_YYYYMMDD" (start_end), values are the override amount.
Example: {"20250301_20250401": 13000} overrides the March 2025 bucket for a monthly frequency starting on the 1st.

RebalanceStrategy.description: The rebalance strategy for the sleeve. Determines how and when the sleeve is rebalanced. - unspecified: The rebalance strategy is not set. - never: Disables all rebalancing. - violations_only: Only rebalances when there are violations. - enabled: Enables regular rebalancing.
